Window Cleaning

Window & Frame Cleaning

Professional cleaning of glass surfaces and frames for crystal-clear views and a well-kept appearance.

Service area

Vienna and surrounding areas, as well as Graz and surrounding areas.

Why professional window cleaning is worthwhile

  1. 01

    Streaks, limescale and reduced visibility look unprofessional

  2. 02

    Outdoor areas are often hard to reach

  3. 03

    Frames and joints collect dust, residue and grime

Our approach

Our glass and frame cleaning service

  • Interior and exterior cleaning with streak-free results
  • Care for frames, grooves and edges
  • Optional preparation before painting or refurbishment

Service scope

Window & Frame Cleaning

Service

Cleaning of interior and exterior windows

Service

Frame and groove cleaning

Service

Optional preparation for repainting or renovation

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you also clean exterior windows in higher locations?
Yes. If required, we use lifts or specialist safety equipment.
How is the price calculated?
Pricing depends on the number of windows, accessibility and scope of work.
Do you offer frame cleaning as well?
Yes. Frame and groove cleaning is part of the service.
Which products do you use?
We work with professional, environmentally conscious cleaning products and take care with sensitive surfaces.
